cells.value: What was missing — and what was added
Audit limited to the files already collected. No app calls, secret reads, connection changes or deployments. Original source evidence retains its dates and limits.
Added Director, Conductor, scope/acceptance/gates, budget boundaries, supervision and role bindings.
Current-team notes take precedence over historic shared-role examples; paused-state evidence remains dated.
Every 14 capability rows and 4 adoption rows now has a direct map placement, plus source-backed memory/transport/ledger/dispatch detail.
161 SDK files inventoried; key documents and 11 implementation modules inspected. Remaining tests/fixtures inventoried, not individually reviewed.
All 84 app labels and all 13 saved AI-surface rows are individually placed in the hierarchy.
No longer an examples-only list. Also accounts for 143 saved skill rows and 21 tool card rows; their historical limits remain visible.
All 883 resource records map to 16 resource groups; all 9 computers and 8 workspaces are individually shown.
Workspaces, Hermes configurations and host observations are not extra machines. Relationship, binding-field and fallback tables are surfaced.
All 51 metadata items accounted for; saved usage and file-reference views linked.
No key values or new 1Password reads; other vaults are outside this evidence.
Added mission records, knowledge reconciliation, maintenance, rebuild guidance and lab evaluation.

838 build-group files inventoried;829 directly decoded text files; 7 nested snapshots held 48 readable members. 2 source workbooks are covered by the workbook audit. Historical instructions are source content, not authority.
1,009 source files, 154 source tabs, 84 apps, 883 assets, 51 credential metadata items and the supplemental screenshot have map destinations.
Accounting and preservation are exhaustive for these collected records. Semantic source review was targeted; this is not a claim that all external systems or every code path were tested.
Earlier map retained as MAP BEFORE COVERAGE AUDIT; other data remains in its existing sheets and original ZIP.
Incoming links to moved map components were retargeted by component identity.
